## Overview

Most applications use the `*Client` types in this library:

- `CertificateManagerClient`: Certificates Manager API allows customers to see and manage all their TLS certificates.

## Quickstart

The following example demonstrates using `CertificateManagerClient`:

```swift
import Foundation
import GoogleCloudCertificateManagerV1
import GoogleCloudLocation
import GoogleLongRunning
import GoogleWKT

func sample(parent: String, ) async throws {
  let client = try GoogleCloudCertificateManagerV1.CertificateManagerClient()
  let items = client.listCertificatesByItems(
    request: ListCertificatesRequest()
  .with {
    $0.parent = "\(parent)"
  }
)
  for try await item in items {
    print("  \(item)")
  }
}
```

## Installation

Add `swift-google-cloud-certificatemanager-v1` as a package dependency:

```bash
swift package add-dependency https://github.com/googleapis/swift-google-cloud-certificatemanager-v1.git --from 0.3.0
```

Then add `GoogleCloudCertificateManagerV1` to your target's dependencies:

```bash
swift package add-target-dependency GoogleCloudCertificateManagerV1 <target-name> --package swift-google-cloud-certificatemanager-v1
```
